edge: a single string (no BinOp: the root is the string itself); % formatting; a concatenation inside a call argument (the root stops at the BinOp); a non-string piece is skipped.
invalid: nodes without parent links raise AttributeError.
not_pinned_on_purpose: The stop argument of concat_string is not exercised: run always calls it without stop.
The order of the pieces in the text follows the recursion of the original, which is pinned through the whole text.
